commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Clearblue
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the Java entry point, update the ASCII banner, and refresh documentation references.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add command echoing and bye handling
commitResults.messageBody: Read user input in a loop, echo regular commands with formatted dividers, and exit with a farewell message when the user enters `bye`.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task storage and list command
commitResults.messageBody: Store up to 100 user-entered tasks and display them in numbered order when the user enters `list`.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task completion tracking with a Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Represent each task as a Task object that owns its description and completion
state. Support marking and unmarking tasks, and display their status consistently
in task lists and command confirmations.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add typed tasks and console UI regression tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Add todo, deadline, and event task types with command parsing,
validation, and type-specific display formatting.

Add a project-specific UI testing skill and exact-output test plan
to verify console behavior after future source-code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: handle invalid chatbot commands safely
commitResults.messageBody:
Validate missing task details, unknown commands, and invalid task
numbers before processing them to prevent runtime errors.

Expand the UI test plan with malformed-input scenarios to verify
that errors are explained clearly without ending the session.

Add a validated delete command that removes the selected task and
renumbers the remaining list without leaving stale array entries.

Extend UI tests to cover successful deletion, list compaction, and
invalid delete commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: use enum for chatbot command types
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce CommandType to represent the fixed set of supported commands
and replace repeated string-based dispatch with an enum switch.

Extend UI coverage to ensure argument-free commands still reject
unexpected extra input after the parsing refactor.
